description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 MAG & +500 MND to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Wind Ability Boost, Triplecast Wind, Unlimited Wind Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Wind Abilities, Wind Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Wind Abilities; Ends after using 8 Wind abilities
TP Max: AOE Wind/NE summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Wind/NE piercing summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has at less than 100/50% HP
WS Blue: Dualcast Wind 3, Instant Wind 3 & Weakess Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: 50% Stoneskin to party & Dualcast Wind 3 and Instant Wind 3 to user
